title: 第9章 笼第10章 阴阳
slug: 本掌门负债成仙第158章陷阱
content_zh:
花乾的一连串行为，成功地拉低了守灵门掌门的信誉，不少门派都决定派人在此地留守，防止她跑了。
守灵门并没有建立在什么大城镇边上，除了归灵真人这一辈，之前的掌门加弟子也就两人，是个在宁梨州显得很另类又孤僻的门派。
四周远离人烟，孤零零地立在这块地界上，不远处就是连绵不绝的墨月森林，里面还处在很原始的状态，据说连妖王都有。
想要在这里驻守，之前人多还好，现在只有几个人就危险了，随时会有妖兽出现。
花乾很贴心，毕竟也是因为师父借了别人的灵石，才让这些弟子留在这里，总不能眼睁睁看着人家住在野地中，还得掏灵石布阵保命。
于是她控制着掌门令，缩小了罩住灵船的范围，然后在外面又加了套护山大阵。
整个法阵看起来像个切了一半的咸蛋，外层围了圈野地，驻守的各债主家弟子，可以在里面自行找块地方搭个住所。
有法阵保护，就完全不用担心入夜之后的安危。
而内层蛋黄就是破损的灵船，它卡在半空中，其他人没有花乾的许可都无法靠近。
花乾带着三小只进了内层法阵，瞧着这二十多丈长的灵船，船头放吞灵炮的地方已经被炸毁，只剩炮座还卡在上面。
她让大家散开，把看起来有用的东西都扔下去，方便站在阵外的修士挑选想要交换的东西。
吞灵炮据说攻击一次就要十万块下品灵石，但也不可能真拿这么多灵石来用，其实说的是十万下品灵石所含的灵气。
换成上品灵石，用几块就足够了。
花乾在吞灵炮残骸那找了半天，想找找看有没有上品灵石，可以给师叔祖用一下。
却发现本应该放灵石的地方，现在空空如也，连消耗掉灵气的废灵石都没有。
可恶！
谁下手这么快？
肯定是北斗宗的弟子在吃里扒外，趁乱把灵石扣下来拿走了。
这种弟子，就应该被逐出师门。
花乾在心中狠狠地骂道，真是气死人了，最好的东西都没了。

现在只能把灵船拆下有用的地方，处理给那些债主。
她目光扫过船体，拆船好累啊，得找个剑修来切割才行，靠自己一点点的拆太过麻烦。
花乾感觉手上没有好用的人，那三只年龄小修为低，其他人又不熟，进来后摸拿走灵材怎么办。
这时候，要是有个高大帅气又忠心耿耿，特别爱干活的强壮修士，哭喊着要加入守灵门就好了。
刚这样想，就听到萧时乐急匆匆地跑了过来，压低声音说道：“师姐，你快过来看看，我们发现了一个人，看起来很怪，不像是北斗宗的弟子。”
“嗯？”花乾皱眉不解，自己已经意达上天了？
这才想要个强壮的修士来干活，现在就送一个过来？
“走，去看看。”她兴致勃勃地跟了上去，想瞧瞧有多怪。
灵船是斜着卡在两崖壁中间，他们都有修为，走起来也不至于站不稳，元宝虽然年龄小，却像只兽崽似的跳来跳去如履平地。
修为不代表心智，只能让他更加的顽皮而已。
那人就在灵船后舱，最大最豪华的房间内，不用猜就知道肯定是庞老祖住的。
花乾走进屋中，就看到元宝和冷魔艳围着个大笼子，元宝正用木剑去戳里面关着的一个人。
咦，笼中人？
content_en:
Hua Gan's series of actions successfully lowered the credibility of the leader of the Soul Watching Sect, and many sects decided to send people to stay here to prevent her from escaping.
The Shou Ling Sect was not built near any big town. Apart from Gui Ling Zhenren, there were only two previous masters and two disciples. It was an unusual and lonely sect in Ningli Prefecture.
It is far away from people and stands alone on this land. Not far away is the endless Black Moon Forest. It is still in a very primitive state. It is said that there is even a demon king.
If you want to garrison here, it was okay if there were many people before, but now it is dangerous if there are only a few people. Monsters will appear at any time.
Huagan was very considerate. After all, it was because the master borrowed other people's spiritual stones that he allowed these disciples to stay here. We couldn't just watch them live in the wilderness and have to dig out spiritual stones to form an array to save their lives.
So she controlled the leader's order, narrowed the area that covered the spirit ship, and then added a mountain-protecting formation outside.
The entire array looks like a half-cut salted egg, with a field surrounded by a circle on the outside. The disciples of the various creditor families stationed there can find a place to build their own homes inside.
With the protection of the magic circle, there is no need to worry about the safety after dark.
The inner yolk is the damaged spiritual ship. It is stuck in mid-air and no one else can approach it without Huagan's permission.
Huagan took three little ones into the inner magic circle and looked at the more than 20-foot-long spirit ship. The place where the spiritual cannon was placed on the bow had been blown up, and only the cannon base was still stuck on it.
She asked everyone to disperse and throw down all the things that looked useful, so that the monks standing outside the formation could choose what they wanted to exchange.
It is said that one attack of the Spirit-Swallowing Cannon costs one hundred thousand low-grade spiritual stones, but it is impossible to actually use so many spiritual stones. In fact, it is talking about the spiritual energy contained in one hundred thousand low-grade spiritual stones.
If you change it to a high-grade spiritual stone, a few pieces will be enough.
Huagan spent a long time looking for the remains of the swallowing spirit cannon, trying to find out if there were any high-grade spiritual stones that he could use for his great uncle.
But he found that the place where the spiritual stones were supposed to be placed was now empty, not even the waste spiritual stones that had consumed the spiritual energy.
hateful!
Who started so quickly?
It must be a disciple of the Beidou Sect who took advantage of the chaos and took the spirit stone away.
This kind of disciple should be expelled from the school.
Huagan cursed fiercely in his heart, he was really angry, the best thing was gone.
Now we can only dismantle the spiritual ship and dispose of the useful parts to those creditors.
She glanced at the hull. It was so tiring to dismantle the ship. She had to find a swordsman to cut it. It was too troublesome to dismantle it bit by bit by herself.
Huagan felt that he didn't have anyone useful. Those three were young and had low cultivation, and the others were unfamiliar. What if they came in and took away the spiritual materials?
At this time, it would be great if there was a tall, handsome, loyal, strong monk who loved to work, crying and wanting to join the Soul Watching Sect.
Just when I thought this, I heard Xiao Shile hurried over and said in a low voice: "Senior sister, come and take a look. We found a person who looks very strange. He doesn't look like a disciple of the Beidou Sect."
"Huh?" Hua Gan frowned in confusion. He had already expressed his intention to heaven?
I just want a strong monk to work for me now, why don’t I send one over now?
"Let's go and have a look." She followed it enthusiastically, wanting to see how weird it was.
The spirit boat was stuck diagonally between the two cliffs. They were both well-educated and could walk without losing their balance. Although Yuan Bao was young, he jumped around like a cub and walked on the ground.
Cultivation does not mean intelligence, it can only make him more naughty.
That person was in the largest and most luxurious room in the back cabin of the spirit ship. It didn't take a guess to know that it must be Patriarch Pang who lived there.
Hua Gan walked into the house and saw Yuan Bao and Leng Moyan surrounding a large cage. Yuan Bao was using a wooden sword to poke a person inside.
Hey, the man in the cage?
